behavior.child_failure: Failed subprocess stdout and stderr are not persisted; the task run records only the exit code.
behavior.spawn_failure: Unexpected scheduler execution exceptions persist only a bounded exception class.
behavior.retry_behavior: Nonzero child exits retain normal retry policy; subprocess launch exceptions retain immediate retry behavior.

coverage: child stdout and stderr diagnostic markers are absent from persisted error arguments
exit code remains available for operator diagnosis
spawn exception details are replaced by the exception class
immediate retry behavior for launch errors is preserved

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked child process and scheduler connection boundaries

limitations: No scheduler process, database, or provider was run.
This does not establish live task recovery, provider recovery, or long-duration worker acceptance.
